faq.q: per-sulii is a Taiwanese brand — can I trust the quality of something made in Taiwan?
faq.a:
Taiwan's biotech research keeps advancing, and skincare quality here just keeps getting better. per-sulii is Taiwanese-researched, a Taiwanese brand, and Made in Taiwan (MIT). We emphasize "Made in Taiwan" because we want more people to know: we can deliver international-grade quality too.

faq.q: Is per-sulii suitable for sensitive skin?
faq.a: per-sulii products contain no retinoic acid, retinal, retinol, fragrance, or artificial coloring. The formula is gentle and non-irritating, so it's suitable for sensitive skin. We recommend a patch test on the inner arm before first use, and to proceed with regular use only once you've confirmed there's no discomfort.

S-essence contains premium, legally sourced exosomes along with multi-peptides and other conditioning ingredients. It helps maintain skin hydration and skin health, leaving your complexion more refined, soft, and radiant.
V-essence is formulated with bee peptide and multi-peptides to fade fine lines and firm and plump the skin — ideal for anyone focused on fine lines or mature-skin care.

faq.q: Can bee peptide cause allergic reactions?
faq.a: Bee peptide is generally suitable for all skin types. If you have a history of allergies to bee products, we recommend a patch test first and proceeding with regular use only once you've confirmed there's no discomfort.

faq.q: Can V-essence and S-essence be used together?
faq.a: Yes. After cleansing, we recommend applying V-essence to the areas of concern first, letting it absorb for about a minute, then applying S-essence evenly over the whole face as part of your daily routine.

faq.q: Can I use it as part of post-aesthetic-treatment care?
faq.a: Yes, once your skin has stabilized after a general beauty treatment or aesthetic procedure and there are no open wounds. If you've had a medical aesthetic procedure, please follow your physician's guidance on skincare use.

faq.q: Can it be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
faq.a: This is a skincare product. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, or have any concerns or a particular skin condition, please consult a physician before use. V-essence is recommended for ages 12 and up.

faq.q: Where can I buy per-sulii products?
faq.a: per-sulii products are sold exclusively through authorized partners. To guarantee genuine, authentic quality, we don't sell directly online. Please contact one of the authorized partners listed on our official website.
Unopened, the shelf life is 2 years. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, we recommend using it within 6 months.

faq.q: What should I do if there's a product defect or I experience discomfort?
faq.a:
Product defect: if the packaging is damaged or defective, please contact the authorized partner you purchased from.
Discomfort: stop using the product immediately and contact the partner you purchased from, or per-sulii's official customer service. If symptoms persist, please seek medical attention promptly.
